description: Use when an agent needs a contract value that none of the typed routes covers: it runs any read-only call with your own calldata on five chains and returns the raw 32-byte result plus asUint, so you can decode it yourself. The escape hatch, not the first choice. Do not use for balances, allowances, token data or NFT owners: those have typed routes that decode the answer for you. No API key, no rate limit. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

block.description: Block tag or number. Defaults to latest.

from.description: Optional caller address, for calls that check msg.sender.

name: evm_call
title: Raw contract call
